branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A range of farmhouse pressed, uncooked-paste cheeses from the Couserans in Ariège, sold under a commercial brand within the Tomme des Pyrénées IGP. It is made from sheep's, goat's or cow's milk, raw, thermised or pasteurised depending on the variety, and ripened 3 to 6 months.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
